zh_CN: 吸附附近敌人0.85秒，造成一次45%元素伤害并施加2秒致盲
en: Pulls nearby enemies for 0.85 seconds, deals 45% Elemental Damage once, and blinds them for 2 seconds.

zh_CN: 首次命中时，在命中位置立刻追加一次攻击
en: The first hit immediately triggers another attack at the impact point.

zh_CN: 命中后延迟0.5秒后从高空劈下闪电，造成60%元素伤害
en: On hit, calls down a lightning strike after 0.5 seconds, dealing 60% Elemental Damage.

zh_CN: 命中时释放震荡波，向四周推开附近敌人
en: On hit, releases a shockwave that pushes nearby enemies outward.

zh_CN: 命中后施加燃烧，每0.5秒造成10%元素伤害；散落种子可形成持续3秒的火焰池
en: Applies Burning on hit, dealing 10% Elemental Damage every 0.5 seconds. Scattered seeds can form fire pools lasting 3 seconds.

zh_CN: 命中点生成持续3秒的寒冰领域，敌人首次接触时受到25%元素伤害并减速40%
en: Creates an ice field at the impact point for 3 seconds. Enemies entering it take 25% Elemental Damage on first contact and are slowed by 40%.

zh_CN:
命中后召唤纯白大剑，延迟0.5秒落下，造成65%元素伤害并施加感光。
感光：下一次受伤增加30%，随后消耗
en:
On hit, summons a white greatsword that falls after 0.5 seconds, dealing 65% Elemental Damage and applying Photosensitivity.
Photosensitivity: the next hit deals 30% more damage, then consumes the effect.

zh_CN: 命中后释放闪电链，对当前目标和范围内另一个目标造成55%元素伤害，并施加0.5s麻痹
en: On hit, releases chain lightning that deals 55% Elemental Damage to the current target and one nearby enemy, paralyzing them for 0.5s.

zh_CN: 投射物命中目标后仍可继续飞行，额外命中2个敌人
en: Projectiles continue after impact, hitting 2 additional enemies.

zh_CN: 生成2个45%原伤害的子攻击
en: Creates 2 child attacks, each dealing 45% of the original damage.

zh_CN: 命中时对周围敌人造成一次45%元素伤害并打湿5秒，使其减速20%
en: On hit, deals 45% Elemental Damage to nearby enemies and wets them for 5 seconds, slowing them by 20%.

zh_CN: 命中后释放月牙风刃，造成70%元素伤害并推开敌人
en: On hit, releases a crescent wind blade that deals 70% Elemental Damage and pushes enemies away.

zh_CN: 解锁全部普通、精良遗物库
en: Unlock all common and uncommon relics

zh_CN: 解锁全部传说、虚空遗物
en: Unlock all legendary and void relics

zh_CN: 解锁全部基础、精良武器
en: Unlock all basic and uncommon weapons

zh_CN: 开局额外获得一件随机遗物
en: Start with one additional random relic

zh_CN: 锻造、修复各类求生兵器，工匠不断改良武器来适配敌人。
en: Forge and repair survival weapons. The artisans keep refining their designs to face new enemies.

zh_CN: 武器图鉴解锁、武器基础强化
en: Unlock weapons and improve their base stats

zh_CN: 幸存者锤炼近身搏杀技艺的训练场，锤炼肉身与兵器的配合，近战流派基础特训设施。
en: A training ground where survivors hone close combat, learning to wield body and blade as one.

zh_CN: 近战专属营地建筑，解锁近战物理升级选项
en: Melee camp building; unlocks physical melee upgrades

zh_CN: 幸存者在此交流遗物组合战术，议事厅墙上悬挂的古老图腾。
en: Survivors gather beneath ancient totems to exchange relic-combination tactics.

zh_CN: 强化套装与通用成长收益
穹顶内最基础的防御与修整设施，为幸存者提供稳定庇护。
en: The dome's essential shelter and recovery facilities offer survivors a safe haven.

zh_CN: 生存防御类加成，平衡建筑
用于训练远程弹道与精准打击的高台。
en: An elevated range for practicing trajectories and precision strikes.

zh_CN: 远程专属营地建筑，解锁远程与投射物相关升级选项
en: Ranged camp building; unlocks ranged and projectile upgrades

zh_CN: 收纳幸存者带回的奇异物品，随着不断收集外来遗物，幸存者们也逐渐了解敌人。
en: Stores strange objects brought back by survivors. Each new relic helps them understand their enemies.

zh_CN: 遗物图鉴解锁、遗物套装预览
初始最大生命 30；每升一级，最大生命 +1，并回复 1 点生命。
en: Starts with 30 Max HP. Each level grants +1 Max HP and restores 1 HP.

zh_CN: 附魔基础掉率6%，每次最多1个；白/绿/蓝/紫占比10/60/25/5，档内等权。幸运与掉落加成采用有上界的递减收益；本波每生成1个附魔，普通怪后续概率乘45%。前5波所有来源合计最多3个，之后4个；连续两次完成且击杀至少8个有效敌人的战斗没有附魔，第二次波末补1个。波末自动收取附魔。精英遗物仍使用独立的逐次减半规则。
en: Base enchantment drop chance: 6%, at most 1 per drop. Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic weights: 10/60/25/5, equal within each tier. Luck and drop bonuses have capped diminishing returns. Each enchantment generated this wave multiplies subsequent normal-enemy chances by 45%. All sources share a cap of 3 in waves 1–5, then 4. If two completed waves in a row each have at least 8 eligible kills and no enchantment drops, one is granted at the end of the second wave. Enchantments are collected automatically at wave end. Elite relic drops use a separate successive-halving rule.

zh_CN: 附魔基础掉率60%，每次最多1个；白/绿/蓝/紫占比0/35/50/15，档内等权。幸运与掉落加成采用有上界的递减收益；本波每生成1个附魔，普通怪后续概率乘45%。前5波所有来源合计最多3个，之后4个；连续两次完成且击杀至少8个有效敌人的战斗没有附魔，第二次波末补1个。波末自动收取附魔。精英遗物仍使用独立的逐次减半规则。
en: Base enchantment drop chance: 60%, at most 1 per drop. Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic weights: 0/35/50/15, equal within each tier. Luck and drop bonuses have capped diminishing returns. Each enchantment generated this wave multiplies subsequent normal-enemy chances by 45%. All sources share a cap of 3 in waves 1–5, then 4. If two completed waves in a row each have at least 8 eligible kills and no enchantment drops, one is granted at the end of the second wave. Enchantments are collected automatically at wave end. Elite relic drops use a separate successive-halving rule.

zh_CN: 附魔基础掉率15%，每次最多1个；白/绿/蓝/紫占比5/45/40/10，档内等权。幸运与掉落加成采用有上界的递减收益；本波每生成1个附魔，普通怪后续概率乘45%。前5波所有来源合计最多3个，之后4个；连续两次完成且击杀至少8个有效敌人的战斗没有附魔，第二次波末补1个。波末自动收取附魔。精英遗物仍使用独立的逐次减半规则。
en: Base enchantment drop chance: 15%, at most 1 per drop. Common/Uncommon/Rare/Epic weights: 5/45/40/10, equal within each tier. Luck and drop bonuses have capped diminishing returns. Each enchantment generated this wave multiplies subsequent normal-enemy chances by 45%. All sources share a cap of 3 in waves 1–5, then 4. If two completed waves in a row each have at least 8 eligible kills and no enchantment drops, one is granted at the end of the second wave. Enchantments are collected automatically at wave end. Elite relic drops use a separate successive-halving rule.

zh_CN: 保持中距离飞行，靠近时后退、远离时追近。短暂蓄力后显示狭窄音波路径，随后向锁定方向喷吐像素螺旋音波。占普通小怪生成概率的30%。
en: Flies at medium range, retreating when you approach and following when you move away. Briefly charges, marks a narrow path, then fires a pixel spiral soundwave in the locked direction. Makes up 30% of normal enemy spawns.

zh_CN: 全覆钢甲、持巨盾与单手锤的小Boss，基础生命独立设为200，不再按普通怪生命倍增，护甲2倍。首波不生成；其余波次基础期望为波次/10，侵蚀最多增加100%，单波最多3只；波初按期望抽取数量，仅前半段生成。与普通怪一起受侵蚀的生命、攻击、护甲加成影响。玩家进入240距离且冷却就绪时蓄力1秒，再用0.16秒冲刺挥锤；无箭头直角矩形预警内部不透明度12%，两侧红色边缘及方粒脉动。遗物选择奖励落地即计入衰减，拾取后通过升级奖励弹窗选择。
en: A miniboss in full plate with a greatshield and hammer. Base HP is 200 independently of normal-enemy scaling; armor is doubled. Does not spawn in wave 1. Later waves have a base expected count of wave/10, increased by up to 100% through Corruption, capped at 3 per wave. The count is rolled at wave start; spawns occur in the first half. Corruption also increases its HP, damage, and armor. When the player is within 240 range and its cooldown is ready, it charges for 1 second, then dashes and swings over 0.16 seconds. Its rectangular warning has no arrow, 12% interior opacity, red edges, and pulsing square particles. Relic rewards count toward diminishing drops as soon as they land; collect them to choose through the reward panel.

zh_CN: 最基础的近战追踪小怪示例。
en: A basic melee enemy that pursues the player.

zh_CN: 幽蓝骨纹与尾焰的小Boss，与钢甲骑士等概率共用小Boss刷新配额。锁定落点预警后扑跃震地，落地迅速回到待机；喷吐幽蓝火焰前显示扇形预警，单次喷吐最多命中3次。震地与火焰命中均击退玩家。
en: A miniboss with blue spectral bone markings and a flaming tail. Shares the miniboss spawn quota with the Ironclad Knight at equal odds. Marks a landing point, leaps into a ground slam, then quickly returns to idle. A cone warns of its blue flame breath, which can hit up to 3 times per cast. Both the slam and flames knock the player back.

zh_CN: 从第4波起，上一波战斗观察至少15秒，且同类敌人中至少80%在首次受伤后1秒内死亡、玩家未明显吃力时，下一波额外加血。小怪至少20个样本，每次加10个百分点、最多60%；小Boss至少1个样本，每次加5个百分点、最多30%。吃力时回退一档，或连续两波秒怪比例低于50%时回退一档。
en: From wave 4, the next wave gains HP if the previous combat lasted at least 15 seconds, at least 80% of an enemy type died within 1 second of first damage, and the player was not struggling. Requires 20 normal-enemy samples or 1 miniboss sample. Normal enemies gain 10 percentage points per step, capped at 60%; minibosses gain 5, capped at 30%. Drops one step if the player struggles or rapid kills stay below 50% for two consecutive waves.

zh_CN: 波初读取侵蚀，所有怪物获得独立乘区加成。每点侵蚀增加生命1.8%、伤害0.9%、护甲1.35%；超过30、60的部分各额外增加生命1.8%、伤害0.3%，持续增长，不封顶。
en: Corruption is read at wave start and applies a separate multiplier to all enemies. Each point adds 1.8% HP, 0.9% damage, and 1.35% armor. Points above 30 and above 60 each add another 1.8% HP and 0.3% damage. Scaling continues without a cap.

zh_CN: 金币 + %d，本次关闭银行，理智-5，幸运-2
en: Gold +%d. The bank closes for this visit. Sanity −5, Luck −2.

zh_CN: 钱不够？没关系。总有可以交易的东西。
en: Short on gold? No problem. There's always something to trade.

zh_CN: 有我帮你理财，不用担心！只是得付出一点小小的代价。
en: Let me manage your money. Nothing to worry about! Just one tiny price to pay.
Principal +%d. Start the next wave immediately.

zh_CN: 这些零碎有什么好买的？
en: Why waste your money on these trinkets?
Gold +%d. Deposits are unavailable this visit.

zh_CN: 别急着存钱，拿去花，下回可别忘了我。
en: No rush to save. Go spend it—and remember me next time.

zh_CN: 存入 %d 金币，获得 1 次免费的强力刷新
en: Deposit %d gold to gain 1 free Power Reroll

zh_CN: 强力刷新：拥有100幸运加成，且保底一件史诗遗物。
en: Power Reroll grants +100 Luck and guarantees at least one Epic relic.

zh_CN: 再存一点，我给你看看真正的好东西。
en: Deposit a little more, and I'll show you the good stuff.

zh_CN: 伤害范围 +40，元素伤害 +8，理智值 −15。
伤害范围 +20，伤害加成 +12；获得后每完成一波，伤害范围再 +2。
en: Damage Area +20; Damage Bonus +12. Each wave completed after acquisition grants another +2 Damage Area.

zh_CN: 获得时：本金 +100；利率 +2%；攻击速度 -12
en: On acquisition: Principal +100. Interest Rate +2%; Attack Speed −12.

zh_CN: 本金归零时触发：立即获得当前金币 ×2 的本金，并获得复活次数 + 1
en: When Principal reaches zero, immediately gain Principal equal to twice your current gold and +1 Revive.

zh_CN: 每两秒生成 1 点护盾；侵蚀度 + 5
生命值低于 50% 时，护甲 + 25
护甲 + 15；每点侵蚀度提供 1 点护甲
en: Armor +15; Armor +1 per point of Corruption

zh_CN: 每满100本金，最大生命 + 1；本金减少时相应加成消失，增加上限不会恢复当前生命；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Max HP +1 per full 100 Principal. The bonus falls when Principal decreases; increasing Max HP does not heal you. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 利率 +1 个百分点；每次收到正数利息后，利率再 +0.2 个百分点
en: Interest Rate +1 percentage point. Each positive interest payment received grants another +0.2 percentage points.

zh_CN: 每秒回血 +0.5；额外复活次数 +1，使用后消耗；持有期间每次复活后侵蚀度 +20；最多持有 1 件
en: HP Regen/s +0.5. Grants 1 extra Revive, consumed on use. While held, every revival adds +20 Corruption. Stack limit: 1.
Gain 10 Shield at each wave start

zh_CN: 伤害范围 +30，伤害加成 +15，攻击速度 −6。
en: Damage Area +30; Damage Bonus +15; Attack Speed −6.

zh_CN: 每次结算利息的时候有20%的概率翻倍
en: Each interest settlement has a 20% chance to pay double.

zh_CN: 利率 + 2 个百分点；每满 5 侵蚀度再提供利率 + 0.5 个百分点；每波开始时侵蚀度 + 1；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Interest Rate +2 percentage points, plus another +0.5 per full 5 Corruption. Corruption +1 at each wave start. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 负载 + 10；移动速度 - 12；拾取范围 - 10
en: Load Capacity +10; Movement Speed −12; Pickup Range −10

zh_CN: 获得时：本金 +（20×当前波次）；最多持有 5 件
en: On acquisition: Principal +(20 × current wave). Stack limit: 5.

zh_CN: 最大生命值 + 5、护甲 + 15；每秒回血 - 0.1；侵蚀度 + 2；理智值 - 2
en: Max HP +5; Armor +15; HP Regen/s −0.1; Corruption +2; Sanity −2

zh_CN: 攻击距离 +25，伤害范围 +25，伤害加成 +20，侵蚀度 +5。
en: Attack Range +25; Damage Area +25; Damage Bonus +20; Corruption +5.

zh_CN: 每次成功收到利息后，通用伤害 + 2%，理智值 - 1；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Each positive interest payment received grants All Damage +2% and Sanity −1. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 通用伤害 + 25%；理智值 - 20；每局最多持有 1 件
en: All Damage +25%; Sanity −20. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 利率 + 5%；每波开始自动注入你当前持有金币 10% 的免费本金
en: Interest Rate +5%. At each wave start, gain free Principal equal to 10% of your current gold.

zh_CN: 每满100本金，攻击距离＋3、伤害加成＋3%，上限30
en: Every full 100 Principal grants Attack Range +3 and Damage Bonus +3%, each capped at +30.

zh_CN: 已有复活次数用尽后，若本金至少1000，致死伤害会消耗500本金并恢复扣款后最大生命的50%；每局仅触发一次，最多持有 1 件
en: After all other Revives are spent, if Principal is at least 1,000, lethal damage consumes 500 Principal and restores 50% of your Max HP after payment. Triggers once per run. Stack limit: 1.

zh_CN: 幸运 + 18；每波结束理智值 + 1；金币获取 + 20%；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Luck +18; Sanity +1 at each wave end; Gold Gain +20%. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 金币获取 +15%；经验获取 +15%；最大生命值 -2
en: Gold Gain +15%; Experience Gain +15%; Max HP −2

zh_CN: 本波开战前手动存入至少50金币，本波利率 +6 个百分点；未达标仍按原利率结息；最多持有 1 件
en: Manually deposit at least 50 gold before the wave to gain +6 percentage points of Interest Rate for that wave. Otherwise, interest is paid at the normal rate. Stack limit: 1.

zh_CN: 每满500本金，金币获取 + 10%，理智 - 2；取出本金会撤销对应加成与代价，理智回升仍受轮回业火之烛限制；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Every full 500 Principal grants Gold Gain +10% and Sanity −2. Withdrawals remove the corresponding bonus and cost; Sanity recovery is still blocked by Candle of Rebirth's Hellfire. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 每秒回血 + 0.75；利率 - 1 个百分点
en: HP Regen/s +0.75; Interest Rate −1 percentage point

zh_CN: 攻击距离 +40，伤害加成 +30；每满10点正攻击距离加成，额外伤害范围 +5。
en: Attack Range +40; Damage Bonus +30. Every full 10 points of positive Attack Range bonus grants another +5 Damage Area.

zh_CN: 每 100 本金提供通用伤害加成 + 1%
暴击几率 +12 个百分点；暴击伤害 +35 个百分点
en: Crit Chance +12 percentage points; Crit Damage +35 percentage points

zh_CN: 攻击距离 +35，远程伤害 +3，攻击速度 −8。
en: Attack Range +35; Ranged Damage +3; Attack Speed −8.

zh_CN: 护甲 +12；移动速度 +18；理智值低于60时，取消这18点移速加成
en: Armor +12; Movement Speed +18. The +18 speed bonus is disabled below 60 Sanity.

zh_CN: 每波结束理智值 + 2；通用伤害 - 8%；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Sanity +2 at each wave end; All Damage −8%. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 获得时：本金 +150；利率 +2%；回血 -0.25；血包恢复量 -1
en: On acquisition: Principal +150. Interest Rate +2%; HP Regen/s −0.25; Health Pickup Recovery −1.

zh_CN: 负载上限 +10；当前本金每满 500，额外 +5 负载上限，上限20
en: Load Capacity +10. Every full 500 Principal grants another +5 Load Capacity, up to +20 extra.

zh_CN: 每秒回血 + 0.4；每波过后，理智值 - 1
en: HP Regen/s +0.4; Sanity −1 after each wave

zh_CN: 每秒回血 + 0.6；最大生命值 - 1；理智值 - 3
每经过 3 波，额外触发一次利息结算
en: Every 3 waves, trigger one extra interest settlement.

zh_CN: 每个回合结息次数 + 1；每局最多持有 1 件
en: One additional interest settlement per wave. Stack limit: 1 per run.
Automatically gain +15 Principal at the start of each wave.

zh_CN: 最大生命值 + 3；移动速度 + 10；理智值 - 5
攻击速度 +12；连续静止1秒后，额外攻击距离 +40、伤害加成 +20；移动立即取消额外加成。
en: Attack Speed +12. After standing still for 1 second, gain Attack Range +40 and Damage Bonus +20. Moving immediately removes these extra bonuses.

zh_CN: 幸运 + 75；经验获取 + 35%；理智值无法再回复；每波结束侵蚀度 + 1；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Luck +75; Experience Gain +35%. Sanity can no longer recover. Corruption +1 at each wave end. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 通用伤害 + 40%；每波结束理智值 - 3，触发前理智低于0时改为 - 5；每局最多持有 1 件
en: All Damage +40%. At each wave end, lose 3 Sanity, or 5 if Sanity is already below 0. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 获得时：本金 +100；利率 +2 个百分点；金币获取 -10%；商店价格 +10%
en: On acquisition: Principal +100. Interest Rate +2 percentage points; Gold Gain −10%; Shop Prices +10%.

zh_CN: 移动速度 + 32；每10点移速提供护甲+1
en: Movement Speed +32; Armor +1 per 10 Movement Speed

zh_CN: 利率 + 4 个百分点；每波结束理智值 - 3；每局最多持有 1 件
en: Interest Rate +4 percentage points; Sanity −3 at each wave end. Stack limit: 1 per run.

zh_CN: 最大生命＋5；每3点侵蚀度＋1理智
投射物数量 +1；通用伤害 -15%；多弹可扩大攻击覆盖，部分武器不会对同一目标重复命中；最多持有 1 件
en: Projectiles +1; All Damage −15%. Extra projectiles increase coverage; some weapons cannot hit the same target repeatedly. Stack limit: 1.

zh_CN: 幸运 + 18；经验获取 + 12；掉落率 + 12；理智值 - 5
